units: Money in integer pence (_p), prices in integer hundredths (_h), durations in the unit their key names; rates and shares are decimal strings, read with Decimal.

rule.summary: In a flagged GB or IE horse-racing WIN market with at least 5 active runners, at off - 300 s, take the shortest runner whose best back is 1.50 to 5.90 with a best lay exactly 3 or 4 CLASSIC ticks above it; send a 2.00 BACK at the best lay - 1 tick, then a 2.00 LAY at the best back + 1 tick; let both rest; at off - 60 s cancel whatever is unmatched; a matched part rides to the result.

market.country_source: event.countryCode in the fresh catalogue row

rule.off: marketStartTime in the fresh catalogue row; the event's openDate is never the off

prefilter.read: one listMarketBook with EX_BEST_OFFERS and virtual prices on, per market on Pilot 1's scheduler list
prefilter.flag: isMarketDataDelayed is true and some ACTIVE runner meets rule.selection
prefilter.book_not_delayed: discarded; never evidence and never a reason to read the live key

rule.evidence: After the reservation, one fresh live-key catalogue row and one decision book with isMarketDataDelayed false and virtual prices on; classified once into one PLACE or SKIP record; no second fetch.

selection.in_band: ACTIVE; best back b and best lay l both on the CLASSIC ladder; b < l
selection.choice: the lowest b, then the lowest l, then the lowest selection id; a tie is never a SKIP

back.limit_price: the decision book's best lay - 1 CLASSIC tick

lay.limit_price: the decision book's best back + 1 CLASSIC tick

legs.send_book: each leg on its own fresh live-key send book with virtual prices on; V0-V14 and V9b, with V13 at most 3 ticks
legs.passive_check: on the leg's send book, best back < leg price < best lay, our own resting BACK included; otherwise leg_not_passive, the leg is not sent and the market is latched
legs.incomplete_pair: BACK sent and LAY not sent (not passive, refused, late, FAILED or UNKNOWN): whole-cancel the BACK at once with KILL cases 1-4; the decision is pair_incomplete

cancel.procedure: read both legs by bet id; whole-cancel each leg still EXECUTABLE, the LAY first, one instruction per request; read both legs again
cancel.matched: rides to the result; nothing is hedged, exited, re-priced, replaced or retried
cancel.failed: auto-kill: KILL file, close the open, Pilot 2's own-scope kill as a child process, then the handoff
cancel.market_suspended: cancel_market_suspended, no auto-kill; read status and legs every 5 s; one more whole cancel if the market reopens before the off; otherwise LAPSE acts

money.worst_race_reason: the LAY fully matched and its runner wins; per outcome, with no hedge credit, the BACK's loss is in the other outcome
money.day_stop_reading: hard_ceiling: a PLACE only if the day's worst-case equity minus 1000p stays at or above -2000p
money.pilot_stop_reading: a PLACE only if the pilot's worst-case equity minus 1000p stays at or above -10000p

drill.probe: LAY 1.00 @ 1.01 plus BACK 1.00 @ 1000 on one runner
drill.ledger: outside Pilot 2's ledger, inside the overall budget

money.overall_budget: open: Yu decides at the build consent (Pilot 1 -99000p + Pilot 2 -10000p + drills -800p against 100000p)
money.separate_from_pilot_1: Pilot 2's ledger starts at 0p; nothing of Pilot 2 enters Pilot 1's slots, pause or running total

placement_limits.counts: PLACE records, not submitted instructions; a PLACE takes its lifetime slot and day slot in its own append
placement_limits.reservations: every reservation uses up its market, SKIP included; no reservation is ever released
placement_limits.sessions: at most one pilot session a UTC day across both pilots; never on a day with a Pilot 1 session; arming refused while any Pilot 1, manual or Bet Angel bet of ours is open or unsettled

caps.config_names: orders.caps.<name without its unit suffix>, and orders.rules.external_exposure_tolerance, in config-p2.json

shared_with_contract_p1.reading: per leg and per bet id, exactly as contract p1 defines them; C rows also keep placedDate and matchedDate

ledger.W: minus risk.worst_case_market_loss over the decision's legs, with no hedge credit, using checked current-order reads; before those reads, -1000p
ledger.contradiction: the decision returns to -1000p and a review stop is set
S_requires: a P2-PT4 receipt with a matched, settled LAY
ledger.commission: commission_rate on each market's net, never per bet

measurement_classes.unit: one PLACE record: one market, one runner, up to two legs
measurement_classes.rule: each PLACE record ends in exactly one class; the first that applies wins; a decision with no fill is eligible and worth 0
measurement_classes.post_decision_removal: includes a non-runner whose reduction factor of 2.5% or more cancels unmatched lays

value_at_bsp.inputs: final matched sizes mB at price B and mL at price L
value_at_bsp.commission: commission_rate off whichever net is positive
value_at_bsp.value: p * net_win + (1 - p) * net_lose, with p = 1 / BSP

verdict.INVALID: any protocol_violation, including the day's or the pilot's worst-case equity ever below -2000p or -10000p
FAIL_if_any: a sent leg is still EXECUTABLE at the off, so LAPSE removes it; cancels refused while the market was suspended are counted apart
more than one PLACE record needed an auto-kill or a handoff to Yu, suspended-market cases apart
verdict.PASS: lifetime_place_records PLACE records with none of the above
verdict.INCOMPLETE: placing ended earlier with none of the above; reported as 'no failure in k decisions', never as PASS

tables: D4 value at BSP by inventory state and price band
D6 settled profit and the running total
reporting.tables_rule: registered before the first PLACE record, computed once after the data lock, never deciding; groups under 30 values listed without intervals; P2-PT4 decisions shown apart
reporting.interim: counts and codes only, on Pilot 1's allowlist, plus legs sent, legs refused as not passive, inventory-state counts and pre-filter flags
reporting.publication: nothing enters Git or reports/ unless Yu approves the exact fields

placing_ends_at_first_of: no pilot room with nothing pending
a breach of the Pilot 2 page
